name: salesforce
description: Access Salesforce CRM data via the Salesforce-hosted MCP gateway. Opportunities, accounts, contacts, and SOQL queries.

connection.instructions:
Obtain a Salesforce OAuth access token and paste it below.

Quickest method — Salesforce Workbench:
1. Go to workbench.developerforce.com → Login → select your environment
2. After login, go to Utilities → REST Explorer
3. Click "Session Information" — the sessionId value is your access token

Alternatively, use the Salesforce CLI: `sf org display --target-org <alias> --verbose` and copy the Access Token.

Tokens expire after 2 hours by default. Re-paste a fresh token when the connection stops working.
